title: Collaboration, recovery and scale
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product with bounded collaboration, recovery and scale capabilities while preserving ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1, Construction Graph authority, existing CAD/BIM semantics and Web/Electron parity.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery checkpoints are durable, versioned and traceable to canonical project/document revisions.
Crash/session recovery restores the latest valid recoverable state deterministically without creating a parallel canonical source of truth.
Comments, presence and activity are project-scoped, permission-aware and linked to canonical objects or revisions where applicable.
Collaborative BIM/document changes use versioned transactional semantics; conflicts and merge/resolution lineage are explicit and reproducible.
External references retain source lineage, revision identity and explicit unavailable/stale/unsupported outcomes; cache contents are never authoritative.
Large-model streaming and caching improve bounded access patterns without changing canonical Construction Graph semantics.
Background regeneration uses the existing worker/adapter boundaries, exposes durable job state, and never promotes transient worker output to authority without canonical persistence.
Web and Electron share the same collaboration, recovery, reference, job and performance semantics.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..015 and compatibility baselines remain green and byte-identical unless an explicitly reviewed migration is required.
Performance budgets are stated as observable thresholds for representative recovery, collaboration and large-model workflows and are revision-bound by evidence.
The exact final implementation head is CI-verified, deployment/browser/Electron verified where applicable, and revision-bound before merge.
No protected architecture paths are modified; architecture changes require an ACR.
non_goals: Unbounded real-time co-authoring of every CAD/BIM operation.
Replacing Construction Graph, PostgreSQL or object storage with collaboration caches or client-local stores.
Replacing the renderer or geometry engine.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-015 is VERIFIED and is the current CAD/BIM workflow baseline.
Platform observability and durable worker execution remain available through PLAT-003 and PLAT-004.
Canonical versioning remains governed by DATA-004 and the Construction Graph remains authoritative.
COLLAB-001..004 are the applicable collaboration requirements for this phase.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout P016.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic autosave, recovery and crash-recovery tests.
Multi-user comments, presence and conflict-lineage tests with authorization coverage.
External-reference lineage and stale/unavailable outcome fixtures.
Large-model streaming/cache and background-regeneration tests with worker-boundary proof.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..015 and compatibility baselines remain green and byte-identical.
Observable performance-budget benchmark artifacts bound to the exact implementation revision.
Exact-head deployment plus real-browser/Electron evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering implementation, merge and post-merge verification.

transitions.reason: Release CAD-PARITY-016 as the bounded Phase 8 collaboration, recovery and scale slice after CAD-PARITY-015 reached verified mainline closure and governance re-validation succeeded.

Assign CAD-PARITY-016 implementation to the logical implementation agent after the P015 dependency and P016 registration governance gates passed; implementation must stop at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for Architect review.
